items.title: Brokers point to rising risk of underinsurance in non-standard market
items.summary: Insurance Age reports that Prestige Underwriting survey data highlights incorrect property valuations as a primary driver of underinsurance among brokers.

items.title: River UK Micro Cap proposes cash exit for up to 50% of share capital
items.summary: Investment Week reports that the River UK Micro Cap trust has proposed a cash exit mechanism capped at half of its issued share capital.

items.title: ByteDance secures in-principle approval for Lloyd's captive syndicate
items.summary: TikTok owner ByteDance has reportedly received in-principle approval to establish a captive syndicate at Lloyd's, marking the market's second active captive.

items.title: Samsung Fire lines up KKR and Korean wealth fund to buy out Canopius
items.summary: Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance is reportedly orchestrating a $2.2bn buyout of the remaining 60% stake in Lloyd's specialty group Canopius alongside co-buyers KKR and Korea Investment Corporation.

items.title: Protests spread across Europe as communities push back against AI data center expansion
items.summary: Demonstrators across Dublin, Helsinki, and several European towns have staged protests calling for a moratorium on AI data center construction amid environmental and energy concerns.

items.title: Fidelity International flags four funds in annual Assessment of Value
items.summary: Fidelity International identified four portfolios that failed to provide value out of 71 evaluated funds.
